text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't touch the tests. These are the fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, so it now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days, so it now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events, so it now returns exactly `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing a third book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests and docstring only fix the title, so the author, year and copy count are my choice, based on the `Emma` record in `tests/test_search.py`.
